facts.claim: The Deccan Company had a director remuneration of £300 each.
facts.quote: The remune- ration of the directors was £300 each.

facts.claim: The company had raised £85,000 in cash after two calls of £75,000 each.
facts.quote: The first call was £75,000 in July, and in November, 1887, a second call was made for a second sum of £75,000. The company had now in cash £85,000.

facts.claim: The company was raising about 150 tons of coal a week from the Sangarene coal mines.
facts.quote: They were raising about 150 tons of coal a week from the mine.
